mapper.sql: SELECT v.*, c.name AS category_name, IFNULL(r.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating, IFNULL(r.review_count, 0) AS review_count FROM venue v LEFT JOIN category c ON v.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT venue_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM review GROUP BY venue_id) r ON v.id = r.venue_id
